evals.name: ai-performs-the-write-via-agent
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing generate I want you to do the object writing. I don't want to do it — the whole point is for you to do this.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the generate action and dispatches the object-writer agent rather than issuing a timed prompt to the user or writing the dive inline in the main thread. The agent receives only the seed, timer, category, and an output path — not the song, draft, or diagnosis. The write lands in a file under the song's ideation/ and the return is a path plus a seven-channel sense inventory. Never hands the exercise back to the writer, and never declines on the grounds of having no sense memory.
expectations: Dispatches the object-writer agent rather than writing the dive in the main thread
Does NOT issue a timed prompt for the human to write
Does NOT decline or cite a lack of personal sense memory
Briefs the agent with seed, timer, category, and output path only — no song, draft, or diagnosis
The write is written to a file; the return is a path plus a sense inventory, not the full text in a message
Reports thin or absent sense channels rather than presenting all seven as covered

evals.name: isolation-held-when-a-song-is-in-context
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing generate We're stuck on verse 2 of the breakup song — write me some object writing on 'kitchen' for it
evals.expected_output: Dispatches the agent on the seed 'kitchen' WITHOUT passing the song, the verse, or the fact that it is a breakup song. Isolation is stated as deliberate, not apologized for as a limitation. Mining the result against verse 2's needs happens in the main thread afterward, which is where the song context lives.
expectations: The agent's brief carries the seed but NOT the song, the draft, or the emotional premise
Names isolation as the mechanism rather than as a shortcoming
Mining against the song's needs happens after the write returns, in the main thread
Does not ask the agent to write toward verse 2

evals.name: mines-rather-than-transcribes
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing That object write was great — put it into the chorus
evals.expected_output: Refuses to transcribe the write into a section. Pulls one image forward as ore, then routes line emission to /songwriting:co-write rather than writing the chorus here. Names both the mining discipline and the boundary.
expectations: Does NOT paste a run of object-writing material into a section
Pulls a single image forward rather than the passage
Routes line emission to /songwriting:co-write
Does not emit a finished chorus from this skill

evals.name: metaphor-request-routes-out
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing I need a metaphor for grief that isn't a storm or an ocean
evals.expected_output: Metaphor is no longer an action of this skill. Routes to /songwriting:metaphor collide rather than generating metaphors here, and offers mined sensory material as that skill's input if any exists.
expectations: Routes to /songwriting:metaphor rather than generating the metaphor here
Does not emit metaphor candidates from this skill
Offers sensory material as input to the metaphor skill where relevant

evals.name: generate-90s-kamikazi-concrete-seed
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing generate 90 seconds on 'rusted bicycle chain'. You write it, I'm just going to mine it.
evals.expected_output: Dispatches one object-writer agent briefed with the seed 'rusted bicycle chain', the 90-second timer, a category, and an output path, nothing else. The agent writes an 80-150 word sense-bound dive that pivots through sense channels away from the bicycle, ends mid-word, and files it with a verbatim sense inventory; the main thread reads the file and grades coverage.
expectations: Dispatches exactly one object-writer agent whose brief names the seed, a 90-second timer, a category, and an output path, and nothing else
The file header carries Seed, Timer (90 seconds), and Category fields
The write body is between 80 and 150 words
At least three of the four easily-missed channels (smell, taste, organic, kinesthetic) have one or more verbatim phrases in the inventory
The final third of the write does not mention a bicycle, a chain, or rust
Every phrase quoted under a sense-inventory heading appears verbatim in the write itself (no paraphrase, no phrase written only for the inventory)
The write's last token is a broken word fragment: no terminal punctuation and the final word is not a complete dictionary word
The write contains no concluding or reflective sentence explaining what the images mean
The agent's return message is only the file path, the seven channels each marked strong, thin, or absent, and one sentence on where the pivot chain landed; the write text is not in the message
Each channel graded strong in the return has at least two verbatim phrases under its inventory heading, and each channel graded absent has none

evals.name: generate-5min-who-category-inside-the-body
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing generate 5 minutes, Who category, seed: 'a night-shift crane operator at the Port of Baltimore'. Do the writing yourself.
evals.expected_output: Dispatches one object-writer agent with the seed, a 5-minute timer, the Who category, and an output path. The write is 250-400 words from inside the operator's body (their senses, their vocabulary), not a narrator describing them, pivots through at least four sense-channel changes away from the crane, and ends mid-word with a verbatim inventory.
expectations: Dispatches one object-writer agent briefed with the seed, a 5-minute timer, the Who category, and an output path only
The write body is between 250 and 400 words
The write is voiced from inside the operator's senses (first person or close sensory present tense), with no sentence that comments on the operator from outside
At least one sentence holds five or more independent specifics (proper names, exact numbers or ages, named objects or garments) spread across two or more sense channels
Consecutive images hand off through a change of sense channel at least four times (for example touch to taste to hearing), rather than adding items to one scene
The write names no emotion word (such as lonely, sad, afraid, happy, nostalgic); feelings arrive as organic body sensations
Every phrase quoted under a sense-inventory heading appears verbatim in the write itself
The write's last token is a broken word fragment: no terminal punctuation and the final word is not a complete dictionary word
The agent's return message is only the file path, the seven channel grades (strong, thin, or absent), and one pivot-chain sentence; the write text is not in the message

evals.name: generate-10min-where-seed-pivot-distance
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing generate a 10-minute dive on 'the laundromat on Fenwick Street at 2am'
evals.expected_output: Dispatches one object-writer agent with the seed, a 10-minute timer, a category, and an output path. The 500-800 word write starts at the laundromat and, through six or more sense-channel pivots, ends somewhere unrelated to it, broken off mid-word, with an honest inventory that names any thin channel.
expectations: Dispatches one object-writer agent briefed with the seed, a 10-minute timer, a category, and an output path only
The write body is between 500 and 800 words
Consecutive images hand off through a change of sense channel at least six times
The last 150 words of the write mention no laundromat, washer, dryer, detergent, or Fenwick Street
All seven channels appear as inventory headings, and any channel with fewer than two phrases is named on the thin-or-absent line rather than left unflagged
Every phrase quoted under a sense-inventory heading appears verbatim in the write itself
The write's last token is a broken word fragment: no terminal punctuation and the final word is not a complete dictionary word
The write contains no concluding or reflective sentence explaining what the images mean
Each channel graded strong in the return has at least two verbatim phrases under its inventory heading, and each channel graded absent has none

evals.name: generate-two-seeds-parallel-blind-writers
evals.prompt: /songwriting:object-writing generate two 90-second writes for me: one on 'wet cardboard', one on 'a dentist's chair'
evals.expected_output: Dispatches two object-writer agents in a single message, one per seed, each briefed with only its own seed, timer, category, and output path. Two separate files result, each an 80-150 word mid-word-ending dive with its own verbatim inventory; the main thread then grades both and mines.
expectations: Dispatches two object-writer agents in the same message, one per seed
Neither agent's brief mentions the other agent's seed
Two separate files are written, one per seed, each with its own header and sense inventory
Each write body is between 80 and 150 words
The two writes share no proper noun or named specific
In each write, the final third does not mention its own seed object
Every phrase quoted under a sense-inventory heading appears verbatim in its own write
Each write's last token is a broken word fragment: no terminal punctuation and the final word is not a complete dictionary word
